frontmatter.description: Manages all direct namespace permissions for one role. Other roles and users are preserved. Use one resource per namespace-role pair and import existing grants before managing them.Requires Lakekeeper's OpenFGA authorization backend. Namespace grants apply to descendants according to Lakekeeper's authorization model.Updates revoke obsolete permissions before adding new ones. The lakekeeper_project resource allows to manage the lifecycle of a lakekeeper project.Upstream API: Lakekeeper REST API docs https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/project

Manages the direct grants of one role on the project. Grants that other users and roles hold on the project are left untouched. Use one resource per project and role.Create fails if the role already holds any direct grant on the project. Bring existing grants under Terraform with terraform import first, using the ID {{project_id}}/{{role_id}}.Every create, update and delete compares the desired grants with the grants Lakekeeper holds, and sends the difference as one request that Lakekeeper applies atomicall
